faqs.question: Does BTech Civil Engineering syllabus focus more on theory or practical application?
faqs.answer:
The BTech Civil Engineering syllabus focuses on both theoretical lectures as well as practical work.
With the help of lectures in the curriculum, theoretical concepts are introduced to students, tutorials provide space for solving problems and applications also.
And the labs offer hands-on experience to students who get acquainted with equipment and CAD software. Also, the field projects also allow students to apply their B Tech Civil Engg. skills and knowledge to design and implement communication systems.

placements.overview:
Kasturba Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University - Pitampura Campus, is located in Delhi. Established in 1986, it is a public institute approved by AICTE. Kasturba Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University - Pitampura Campus provides 5 UG and After 10th courses in 4 specialisations, namely Civil Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Electronics Engineering and Fashion Design. Theses programmes are offered in Full Time mode. BCA and After 10th Diploma are some of the courses offered at Kasturba Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University - Pitampura Campus. Some of the streams in which these courses are offered include Engineering, IT & Software and Design. The total fee at Kasturba Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University - Pitampura Campus ranges between INR 31,050 to 1,19,100. Kasturba Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University - Pitampura Campus has a student intake of 544 for all the courses. Kasturba Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University - Pitampura Campus offers all the infrastructural facilities to students.

At the UG and After 10th levels, Kasturba Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University - Pitampura Campus offers a diverse range of progammes. Candidates can choose Full Time courses, from streams like Engineering, IT & Software and Design. College offers BCA courses at the UG level. While, at the After 10th level, the college offers available programmes like After 10th Diploma. The Kasturba Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University - Pitampura Campus course fee ranges between INR 31,050 to 1,19,100.

review_content.General: As it is a design college, I like the infrastructure of our college. Its much of like how a design campus should be with many facilities. Some improvements can be made. Classrooms are satisfactory, spacious, and they have proper ventilation. The library is good with many books so that the students get good information. Sports are also a part of our curriculum. Most of the students use to play basketball, and there are other sports grounds also in our college. The campus canteens are also satisfactory. There are 3-4 canteens on the campus in which the food quality is good and healthy. As I have a friend, who stays in the hostel, from him, I came to know that the hostel rooms are good, and the food provided in the hostel is okay. I faced an issue regarding the infrastructure on the campus. There are many numbers of stairs with very less slope which could be difficult for the disabled. Otherwise, everything is good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Des. in Interior Architecture - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: The university is good and well-maintained.

review_content.Placements: The placements for our senior batch were good, and some of the students got placements when they were presenting their work at the time of exams. When, the industry people, visit to see the work, and they liked the work of the students and appointed them straight away. The university guarantees 100% that everyone gets placements. The average salary ranges between Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 60,000 per month. During the summer vacation, the faculty members make sure that every student gets the internship at the good companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus is made according to the comfort of the students, and they have provided us with lots of facilities like free Wi-Fi facility, many labs for the different kind of work like the metal workshop, computer lab, wood workshop so that we can learn the work done in our stream. The classrooms have the projectors. The campus is centrally air-conditioned. There are the library and sports and games. There is the medical facility for an emergency. There are 6-7 canteens in the campus with the good food. The hostel rooms are like the rooms in the home. I have no issue with the infrastructure.

This college is ranked the 4th best college and it is the only college offering a two in one course (fashion and textile both at the same time). Hence, I am glad to be a part of this college.

review_summary.college_name: School of Design Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.Des. in Interior Design - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Some of the faculty were great but overall, I would not recommend it.

content.Placements: Companies did not come to recruit here. You go and find your own internships and placements; if not, too bad. Most of my batchmates ended up struggling to find anything. I was lucky enough to switch my stream slightly so I had a good job but I was also associated with another university.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is average. For a design school, it was very basic. One classroom is there and there are no labs. There was very limited exposure during the course. Again, I was lucky enough to have that after the course ended. The library is well stocked. The food was average in the canteens.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Interior Design - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Interior designing is a good course. Every day, we learn something new from our faculty.

content.Placements: From the workshops, and information from my seniors, I have noticed that there are good placements for students. Internships are also provided by our college. I don't know much about the salary that is offered to placed students. Different companies visit our college and indulge students in different projects.
content.Infrastructure: As it is a design college, I like the infrastructure of our college. Its much of like how a design campus should be with many facilities. Some improvements can be made. Classrooms are satisfactory, spacious, and they have proper ventilation. The library is good with many books so that the students get good information. Sports are also a part of our curriculum. Most of the students use to play basketball, and there are other sports grounds also in our college. The campus canteens are also satisfactory. There are 3-4 canteens on the campus in which the food quality is good and healthy. As I have a friend, who stays in the hostel, from him, I came to know that the hostel rooms are good, and the food provided in the hostel is okay. I faced an issue regarding the infrastructure on the campus. There are many numbers of stairs with very less slope which could be difficult for the disabled. Otherwise, everything is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Interior Architecture - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: The university is good and well-maintained.

content.Placements: The placements for our senior batch were good, and some of the students got placements when they were presenting their work at the time of exams. When, the industry people, visit to see the work, and they liked the work of the students and appointed them straight away. The university guarantees 100% that everyone gets placements. The average salary ranges between Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 60,000 per month. During the summer vacation, the faculty members make sure that every student gets the internship at the good companies.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is made according to the comfort of the students, and they have provided us with lots of facilities like free Wi-Fi facility, many labs for the different kind of work like the metal workshop, computer lab, wood workshop so that we can learn the work done in our stream. The classrooms have the projectors. The campus is centrally air-conditioned. There are the library and sports and games. There is the medical facility for an emergency. There are 6-7 canteens in the campus with the good food. The hostel rooms are like the rooms in the home. I have no issue with the infrastructure.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Fashion and Textile - Batch of 2015

content.Other: This college has excellent faculty. Ritu Beri is also now a part of Sushant School of Design. The students from our college have already started working with her. Our college has an excellent placement record. It is great to be working with all the great artists. This college is ranked the 4th best college and it is the only college offering a two in one course (fashion and textile both at the same time). Hence, I am glad to be a part of this college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Fashion and Textile - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good college for creative learning

content.Placements: Our class is of 40 students. The highest package is about 60LPA and the average is about 10LPA. Around 90% of our seniors are placed in this year with many top recruiting companies. I, myself doing the free internship and gaining the practical experience
content.Infrastructure: We have both A.C and non A.C which would range about 1.7 to 2.4 lakh per year. With good and clean attached bathroom, 24/7 water supply, good drinking water, 24/7 power back up, good security for both girls and boys. And the food is also of good taste anyone can easy get habituated for the food here.

faqs.question: When is DY Patil Agriculture and Technical University application forms out?
faqs.answer: DY Patil Agriculture and Technical University offers verious UG and PG courses so the application forms release time is different for different courses. Usually the application forms for DY Patil Agriculture and Technical University are released in the first week of January. The applications forms release time is also depends to entrance exmas. For general UG courses the application forms release time depends on CUET/ NEET/ ICAR AIEEA exams timing, usually released in the month of June-August. Similarly, for engineering UG courses the application forms release time depends on JEE Mains timing. And for PG courses the application forms release time dependa on GATE/ MHTCET MTECH exams timing, usually in the month of February-March.Please note that these dates are subject to change, it’s recommended to keep checking the university’s official website for the latest updates and for most accurate and up to date information you can contact  university's admission office.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to B.Tech at DY Patil Agriculture and Technical University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Anyone can get direct admission from the college from the help of Management Quota. The candidates can either contact the institution directly or use some references. Admission is also done online and on campus. The students can also get admissions using the NRI quota. The aspirant should have obtained at least 50% marks (at least 45% marks, in the case of Backward class categories and Persons with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra State only) in the above subjects taken together.

faqs.question: Can I join DY Patil Agriculture and Technical University directly?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can join DY Patil Agriculture and Technical University directly. To join UG courses at DY Patil Agriculture and Technical University directly after 12th, you must be from CBSE board in 12th and the eligibility criteria is 12th with minimum 50%. In DY Patil Agriculture and Technical University for most of the UG courses you can join directly with above mentioned eligibility criteria, but the only UG course that you can't join directly is BFA. To do BFA at DY Patil Agriculture and Technical University, you have to give an exam i.e. MAH AAC CET. On the basis of MAH AAC CET score you can get admission to BFA.DY Patil Agriculture and Technical University also offers PG courses that you can join directly after your graduation and the eligibility criteria is graduation with minimum 50%. But for M.Plan and  M.Tech at DY Patil Agriculture and Technical University you have to give GATE/ MHTCET MTECH any of these exams, on the basis of exam score you can get admission.

review_content.Placements: Placements are available for the final project that is done by the students in their fourth year. Placements weren't offered for my batch during the third year summer internship. Many of the placements for the final project are big names, but they all fall under a more corporate setting.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has an excellent library with a very good selection of design books. Recently the workshops have been refurbished and are in their prime. The media labs and other facilities are great, but getting permissions to use these facilities are getting harder. The studio space offers a creative environment, but Wi-Fi facilities are not the most reliable and only one device per student can be registered to the Wi-Fi. The mess and canteen services are sub par at best. The hostels have the bare minimum but are well maintained. Very little kitchen facilities are present at the hostel and the laundry services are minimum as well. Recently many problems have accorded with the laundry and hostel kitchen and no maintenance has taken place of the same.

review_content.Placements: Since I am still in college and have not passed out yet, I can’t give you the best details on placements. But from what I have heard, my seniors who have passed out and those who tried for internships in the 3rd year have gotten good opportunities with the portfolios they presented.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college campus is well maintained, with a peaceful and green environment that supports focused learning and creativity. The design studios and classrooms are equipped with the basic infrastructure required for hands-on learning, including a common workshop with all kinds of materials and faculty available at all times. Common areas are spacious, and the campus provides a calm space for students to explore. The campus is a favorite place for any nature lover. The hostel facilities are pretty decent, with all essential amenities and infrastructure ensuring a sense of community among students. Security and cleanliness receive due attention, ensuring a safe and hygienic stay.

review_content.Placements: Talking about placements, under communication design itself, there are plenty of career opportunities. Each subject can turn out to be a career. In the future (maybe after the 4th year), students can choose whatever they love to do. In a batch of 20, each person is interested in different branches of design. So, one company cannot come to the college and recruit all students. You should find the company that fits you.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Communication Design - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: A gamble with faculty and courses, good infrastructure and a creative environment.

content.Placements: Placements are available for the final project that is done by the students in their fourth year. Placements weren't offered for my batch during the third year summer internship. Many of the placements for the final project are big names, but they all fall under a more corporate setting.
content.Infrastructure: The college has an excellent library with a very good selection of design books. Recently the workshops have been refurbished and are in their prime. The media labs and other facilities are great, but getting permissions to use these facilities are getting harder. The studio space offers a creative environment, but Wi-Fi facilities are not the most reliable and only one device per student can be registered to the Wi-Fi. The mess and canteen services are sub par at best. The hostels have the bare minimum but are well maintained. Very little kitchen facilities are present at the hostel and the laundry services are minimum as well. Recently many problems have accorded with the laundry and hostel kitchen and no maintenance has taken place of the same.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Industrial Design - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A decent college that can fulfill your design goals.

content.Placements: Since I am still in college and have not passed out yet, I can’t give you the best details on placements. But from what I have heard, my seniors who have passed out and those who tried for internships in the 3rd year have gotten good opportunities with the portfolios they presented.
content.Infrastructure: The college campus is well maintained, with a peaceful and green environment that supports focused learning and creativity. The design studios and classrooms are equipped with the basic infrastructure required for hands-on learning, including a common workshop with all kinds of materials and faculty available at all times. Common areas are spacious, and the campus provides a calm space for students to explore. The campus is a favorite place for any nature lover. The hostel facilities are pretty decent, with all essential amenities and infrastructure ensuring a sense of community among students. Security and cleanliness receive due attention, ensuring a safe and hygienic stay.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Communication Design - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: If you want to learn design, this is the best place.

content.Placements: Talking about placements, under communication design itself, there are plenty of career opportunities. Each subject can turn out to be a career. For example, you learn advertisement, filmmaking, branding, packaging design, UI/UX design, animation, and many other subjects under the umbrella of communication design. In the future (maybe after the 4th year), students can choose whatever they love to do. In a batch of 20, each person is interested in different branches of design. So, one company cannot come to the college and recruit all students. You should find the company that fits you.

overview_faqs.question: Is NCU good for BTech?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, NCU is good for BTech. The School of Engineering and Technology under NCU offers a BTech programme. The course is offered in 7 specialisations namely Full Stack Development, Cybersecurity and Forensics, Cloud Computing, Data Science, Gaming, AR&VR, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning and Blockchain-based. NCU offers BTech courses in collaboration with AWS Academy, Google Cloud, Oracle Academy, Cisco Networking Academy, Nptel and IBM. The courses are offered as part of the curriculum giving students access to the course material from the academic partner and hands-on practical on their platform. NCU has a record of nearly 100% placements of BTech programmes in highly reputed firms like Deloitte, Ernst and Young, TCS, Fidelity etc.

overview_faqs.question: Is LLM available in NorthCap University?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, LLM is available at NorthCap University. It is a PG-level course offered in full-time mode. The duration of this programme is one year. Students enrolled in it get to choose from various specialisations, including Corporate Law, Human Rights Law, and Intellectual Property Rights. Overall, students study different facets of Law.

review_summary.college_name: Northcap University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Business Analytics - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Great college life with a good placement offer.

content.Placements: I must say a full batch of business analytics got placed by university and got an average package of 5 LPA. Almost all the students got a placement if they applied for it, but some students didn't apply for the placement. Our college offers multiple placements and internships in India and abroad, with multiple scholarships and global opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Great infrastructure with a full Wi-Fi campus and a big enough library with most of the books. Our campus has 3 cafes, one inside the building and two in the garden. Our college has a big ground on which students can play, sit, and roam around, and also the whole university is very clean.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Digital Marketing - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The NorthCap University is a very good college for B.Tech. Also, it is good for management.

content.Placements: 85% of students were placed in my college. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Mitsubishi, and many more. For campus placements, college follows a mock interview if you pass the interview, you are eligible for placements and it depends on you.
content.Infrastructure: The NorthCap University is not that big, and it has around 10 acres of land. The overall infrastructure is good. Classrooms are fully equipped. The library has all the books that are recommended by the teacher. Hostel is also good. One thing I can say is that the food is good and cooked with hygiene.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security and Forensics) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The NorthCap University!

content.Placements: There are a lot of companies that come to our college every year for placement drives like TCS, Infosys, HCL, Deloitte, Tata, and Byju's. The average package ranges from 2.5 LPA to 6 LPA. About 50-60% of the students get campus placement with an average salary.
content.Infrastructure: The college campus is well-equipped with Wi-Fi (we are given 2GB of Wi-Fi, which is kind of less). Our classes are fully air-conditioned with good seating from where the board is clearly visible. The food at the campus is also good with varieties available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Great Infrastructure and Facilities.

content.Placements: As we are first-year students, we don't know much about the placements, but from what we have heard from our seniors, they genuinely help us in getting our placements done with the right knowledge and provide guidance through each and every step. The top recruiter is Dell for now.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is amazing. It is equipped with all the things needed by a student. The library is updated with books, classrooms have smart boards, and Wi-Fi is provided to each and every student. The canteen is great, providing yummy snacks.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of placements. Good infrastructure.

content.Placements: They have a very low placement ratio. They show 70% placement, but in reality, out of 600 students, only 100 are eligible to sit for placements. They have terms and conditions like no active backlogs or no backlog till now, and the companies that come here for hiring are offering very low packages.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very decent. They don't have any hostel, but the infrastructure is good; they have Wi-Fi at every corner with decent speed. The library is also up to mark. I would say they have the best canteen, in my opinion. The area of the college is small, which is why it has low sports facilities, but it has good medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Great college life with a good placement offer.
reviews.review_text: Great infrastructure with a full Wi-Fi campus and a big enough library with most of the books. Our campus has 3 cafes, one inside the building and two in the garden. Our college has a big ground on which students can play, sit, and roam around, and also the whole university is very clean.

reviews.review_heading: The NorthCap University is a very good college for B.Tech. Also, it is good for management.
reviews.review_text: The NorthCap University is not that big, and it has around 10 acres of land. The overall infrastructure is good. Classrooms are fully equipped. The library has all the books that are recommended by the teacher. Hostel is also good. One thing I can say is that the food is good and cooked with hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: The NorthCap University!
reviews.review_text: The college campus is well-equipped with Wi-Fi (we are given 2GB of Wi-Fi, which is kind of less). Our classes are fully air-conditioned with good seating from where the board is clearly visible. The food at the campus is also good with varieties available.

reviews.review_heading: Great Infrastructure and Facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is amazing. It is equipped with all the things needed by a student. The library is updated with books, classrooms have smart boards, and Wi-Fi is provided to each and every student. The canteen is great, providing yummy snacks.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of placements. Good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very decent. They don't have any hostel, but the infrastructure is good; they have Wi-Fi at every corner with decent speed. The library is also up to mark. I would say they have the best canteen, in my opinion. The area of the college is small, which is why it has low sports facilities, but it has good medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good Infrastructure and Supportive Faculty. Worth a Try!
reviews.review_text: My university has air-conditioned classrooms, a library, a common room, an amphitheater, an auditorium, Wi-Fi facility, a Thought Lab, a Psychology Lab, cafes, a Maggi Point (NESCAFE outlet), and a sports room for indoor sports like chess, carrom, and table tennis. There are also basketball and badminton areas, multiple washrooms, and drinking water facilities on each floor.

reviews.review_heading: Review: The Northcap University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, with air-conditioned classrooms and a large library containing thousands of books. No hostels are available for boys; hostels are only available for girls, and there are limited seats in the hostels. Many games and sports are available, such as cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Choose the right college for you .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is way to good; they provide us with AC classes, perfect benches, comfortable smart boards and a perfect garden, which gets awarded for the best garden award almost most of the time. It also provides us with 2 cafes and 1 Nescafe, providing healthy food and junk food .

reviews.review_heading: Crowd is not good but the faculty is good. The campus is average but small, no hostel for boys.
reviews.review_text: All the classrooms have projectors for better teaching and creative learning. The students use these projectors for delivering presentations too. The Library is good having adequate collection of books. But the Wi-Fi is not that good and only provides 2GB for each student daily, the downloading speed is very good but the browsing speed is slow. There is only a girls hostel which is located 1KM away from the campus and there is no boys hostel available. The food quality is good in the cafes. Medi...

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is really good, but it is not good for the sports students.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good but there are not a lot of things that should be covered in the facilities. The courses are good. They should also provide boys hostel facilities. They only have female hostel facilities. The hostel food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent faculty and infrastructure with great placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities provided by the universities. Wi-Fi is fully available throughout the campus and labs, classrooms are fully air-conditioned and well-maintained. Libraries are also very clean and fully air-conditioned. The hostel facilities are also very good and the quality of food is also very hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: The Northcap University- Gurgaon.
reviews.review_text: We do not have hostel facilities. Only a girls' hostel is available. Food quality is very average. Wi-Fi and canteen facilities are also available. The taste of food in the canteen is very nice, food tastes like homemade food. Hostel rooms are cleaned every day in the morning.

reviews.review_heading: Strong Industry Connections and Supportive Faculty at The NorthCap University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was available and access was given to all. The library is large enough for a perfectly calm study environment. The classrooms are good, with centralized AC all over the campus. The ground is huge, and the cafe facilities are a bit tiring as they don't deal in cash but only with canteen cards.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the university.
reviews.review_text: Facilities include accommodation for both girls and boys, a health centre, a well-stocked library with both online and sprint resources, a gymnasium, a multipurpose sports ground, a cafeteria, auditorium and well-equipped laboratories. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Good college in terms of infrastructure, safety, and facilities. Faculty are helpful and supportive.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are really nice and well maintained. I am a day scholar, but according to my friends who have told me about hostels, they are not inside the college; they are outside the college, and they are only for girls.

Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, mess etc. were available for the students. Mess and canteen food was good to eat. Multiple sports facilities were available for the students.

individual_reviews.title: Very good teaching quality.

content.Placements: There are no placement facilities, and no company comes for the recruitment. We have to do an internship for our final year, and we all got internships in very reputed companies and boutiques, which gave us a very good experience. We were mostly offered jobs in the textile industry.

Wi-Fi, a well-equipped laboratory, a classroom with a good atmosphere, a very good library, and good washrooms and toilets are there. Hostel facilities are very good, and the quality is also good. Medical facilities are also provided.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Psychology - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: The teaching quality and learning experience here are good.

content.Placements: The average package offered for my course was Rs 3 LPA. The highest package was 5 LPA. The top recruiters are hospitals and private clinics. content.Infrastructure: The campus is wonderful, and the classrooms are good with projectors. The college environment is good for sports activities. There is also a first-aid kit available. The canteen is well maintained. The library also has an updated collection of books.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Textile Science and Fashion Apparel Design - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: The college was very good. I love my college.

paragraphs: According to SNDT Women's University NIRF report 2024, the median package offered during UG 3-year , UG 4-year and UG 5-year placements 2023 stood at INR 1.61 LPA , INR 4.5 LPA and INR 6 LPA , respectively. Further, the median package offered during PG 1-year and PG 2-year placements 2023 stood at INR 2.7 LPA and INR 5 LPA , respectively.

Earlier, according to the NIRF report 2023, 335 UG and 328 PG students were placed during SNDT Women's University placements in 2022. The median package offered to UG students ranges between INR 1.2 LPA and INR 6 LPA. Further, the median package offered to PG students ranges between INR 4.32 LPA and INR 5 LPA.

faqs.answer: Almost 40-50% of MBA students get on-campus placements at Shreemati Nathibai Damodar Thackersey Women’s University (SNDTWU), Churchgate Campus, Mumbai. Companies like TCS and Wipro visit the campus for placements. The average package offered is 2-3 LPA. SNDTWU also has a placement cell that provides training and placement opportunities to students The median placement rate for undergraduate (UG) students in 2022 was 66%, and the median placement rate for postgraduate (PG) students was 85%, with UG students receiving a median package of INR 5,40 LPA and PG students receiving packages of INR 4,32 LPA.

admission_process.title: Alva's Institute of Engineering and Technology Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: Check below the detailed steps for Alva's Institute of Engineering and Technology admission process for BTech and MBA courses:
1: Application

The application process for Alva's Institute of Engineering and Technology is conducted in an online mode. Candidates can apply online on the college's official website. Along with that, they must submit the important documents and an application fee to finalise the application process.
2: Selection Rounds

Alva's Institute of Engineering and Technology admission is entirely entrance-based for UG & PG courses. For the BTech course, candidates must qualify for the KCET or COMED-K entrance exam. Whereas for an MBA, they must qualify for either PGCET/ CAT/ MAT/ KMAT. Candidates are shortlisted based on the application and entrance exam scores and called for the PI round. Candidates must carry hard copies of documents at the time of appearing for the interview.
3: Final Admission

Candidates are notified about their selection. The selected candidates must pay the registration or full fees within seven working days after receiving the confirmation from AIET. They must also submit a photocopy of all the documents as proof at the time of admission.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Coimbatore.
reviews.review_text: The college had a library, labs, and good classrooms. I was not a hostel student. I was a day scholar, and it was awesome. I heard from hostel students in my classroom that there were many games and sports, annual day celebrations, fests, and many other activities in the college.

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: The college provides proper and hygienic hostels. It has a good library, and a digital library is also available. In the case of facilities, everything is top-notch as compared to other colleges around Coimbatore. It also provides free Wi-Fi and digital libraries free of cost.

reviews.review_heading: Good college because of faculty and lab facilities.
reviews.review_text: The biotechnology curriculum and laboratory are good. You would get experiential learning in labs, and various instrumentation is available to help students learn more. Canteens are also available in colleges, and non-vegetarian food is also provided. The snacks taste really good.

reviews.review_heading: College is 7 out of 10, but everything has its own pros and cons, so you’ve to learn how to survive.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a lot of facilities. We can have the respected Wi-Fi, labs, and library time. Recently, our college time has changed, and we are getting a lot of time to explore our campus. The food is great, and we get equal and tasty food on campus at a cheap rate.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in the college are awesome. Classrooms are very clean and comfortable which makes students feel comfortable, healthy, and growing. The hostel will be in a neat state but we do not daily get non-veg so I have been given only 4 stars. Our college gives more importance to sports.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides importance on conceptual learning.
reviews.review_text: They have shown special care in maintaining the laboratories, which are highly protected due to their traditional zones. They strictly monitor whether students follow safety precautions. The libraries are filled with books needed for reference.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is so good, and there are labs and sports training.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are cleaned every day by housekeepers, and the toilets are very clean. The hostels are not bad, but compared to other college hostels, the rooms are cleaner. If we talk about affordability, it is reasonable for students to stay in the hostel. The college gives priority to discipline.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely recommended for career-centric students.
reviews.review_text: Various facilities and amenities are provided to us like extensive cum individual laboratories for the verticals, a vast library with huge digital and paper copies of books, journals, articles, proceeding compiles, and so on. Facilities in the hostel are Wi-Fi, individual/shared cots, a well-furnished relaxing area, and various games or sports facilities for leisure time. But the drawback lies in the food quality which is served to us. I would rate it 3 for its quality (just taste concerned, not...

reviews.review_heading: There is no satisfaction in our college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our department will be awesome, and there will be no regret of your choice. Wi-Fi facility is provided, and the network will be stable. Classrooms are spacious. The library is open every day from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. There are many number of labs for different departments. The hostel is average, but the food provided in the college canteen is clean and neat. There are many staff members are allocated to take care of the hostel students and the food served.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good choice to make a good sound.
reviews.review_text: It is a very independent college for learning more with friendly facilities and a green eco environment. There are many computer labs with updated versions, Chemistry labs, etc. For sports, there is a good training with highly teaching skill teachers. There are good ground facilities and they are maintained in a good manner.

reviews.review_heading: It has a challenging academic environment.
reviews.review_text: Individual accommodation was allotted for girls and boys students. Food lounges, relaxing hall, and sports area for playing badminton were arranged for hostel students. Classrooms were upgraded with necessary tools like LCD projectors, digital boards, and computers with network connectivity.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college with strict dress code and attendance. Bur, placements are not so much with good p
reviews.review_text: Very good facilities like Wi-Fi, laboratories with advanced instruments. Well-furnished peaceful library with e-library facilities also, spacious ground for all types of games and activities. College hostel is near the college. Clean and spacious rooms. Food in hostel and canteen is good and acceptable. Emergency medical assistance is available 24/7 and hospital is nearby, so it is safe and comfortable.

reviews.review_heading: Food and Nutrition-Based Course
reviews.review_text: A proper schedule is assigned to all the students, with specific lunch breaks and tea breaks for all departments. Medical support, incubation rooms, and other facilities are lined up for students' emergencies. A GATE pass with a valid signature from authorities is required to cross the gate during class hours.

reviews.review_heading: Most the busiest days in my life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at Dr. N.G.P. Arts and Science College is average. We have a wifi campus, but it lacks, and it is better to use mobile data. The canteen is good, but the food is average. The hostel facilities are average.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dr. N.G.P. Arts and Science College.

Students applying at NOU should possess a Bachelor's degree or its equivalent in an allied discipline from a recognised institute or university. NOU MSc admission process is merit-based. The application process can be started by visiting the official website of the university.

overview_faqs.question: Does Nalanda Open University provide a valid university degree?
overview_faqs.answer: Nalanda Open University is recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC), the Ministry of HRD, the Government of India and the Distance Education Bureau (DEB). NOU is also a member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), the International Council of Open and Distance Education (ICDE) and the Asian Association of Open Universities (AAOU). Additionally, Nalanda Open University was established in 1987 under the ACT of Bihar Government, Nalanda Open University (NOU).

overview_faqs.question: What are the good and bad sides of studying in Nalanda Open University?
overview_faqs.answer: Nalanda Open University has several pros and cons of studying for various students. The good and bad sides are given below:Good side of studying at NOU:In comparison to other regular universities, NOU is affordable in terms of everything. The tuition fee, along with other fee components is lower.The system of distance learning is flexible for students living in different parts of the nation.NOU offers UG, PG, Diploma and Certificate courses across various specialisations. All these courses are recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and Distance Education Council (DEC). Bad sides of studying at NOU:Due to the distance learning mode, students lack interaction with the faculty. This can impact the learning experience of students. Open universities such as NOU Bihar and Patna IGNOU often lack placement opportunities, practical training and exposure. Students miss out on extra-curricular activities, vibrant college life, fests, events, internships and seminars.

overview_faqs.question: What is the fee structure for MBA in Chaudhary Bansi Lal University?
overview_faqs.answer: Studying MBA at Chaudhary Bansi Lal University (CBLU) costs lower than fees charged by private universities. The MBA course tuition fee at CBLU spans between Rs 60,000 to Rs 80,000 during a two-year period based on student category and specialisation selection.The yearly expenses for students after tuition fees at CBLU consist of registration fees plus examination fees combined with library fees together with miscellaneous expenses ranging from Rs 5,000 to Rs 10,000 yearly. Students who choose to stay in the hostel should expect annual fees between Rs 25,000 and Rs 40,000 including meal costs. Qualified education scholarships exist specifically for students who belong to reserved categories as well as economically challenged sections. The MBA programme at CBLU provides students with an affordable choice for pursuing management education.

Fee costs depend on the chosen course and field of study at Chaudhary Bansi Lal University.Annual fees for B.Sc. programs span from Rs 8000 to 15000 based on the selected subject. The annual fees for B.Com. and B.A. programs at CBLU fall within the range of Rs 7,000 to Rs 12,000. Students need to spend Rs 20,000 to Rs 35,000 annually for either BBA or BCA programs.The annual costs to study B.Tech. fall within Rs 50,000 to Rs 80,000 based on the specific branch. Students must pay separate fees for exams together with library fees and hostel fees that cost from Rs 30,000 to Rs 50,000 every year. The institution provides scholarships which combined with fee concessions for students from reserved categories.

review_summary.college_name: CBLU Bhiwani Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LLB. - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied with faculty and staff. Main thing is that parking facility is not there.

content.Placements: Placements were not so good. 30 to 35 percent of students were placed. The highest package was Rs 40,000, and minimum was Rs 8,000. Its very difficult to survive in life after taking a degree from this college because the education system was very bad. Placements were very low, and students were facing a lot of problems there.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of college campus was good. Hostel was not so good, it was in bad condition. The rooms in the hostel were so small. There was no place to park vehicles inside the college, and vehicles were also not allowed to enter the college. There was no facility for auto inside college so students faced many problems.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of Adarsh Mahila Mahavidyalaya.

content.Placements: As per the B.A. degree, relatively expected placements are low, as most students opt for higher education, or they prefer professional courses. The average package ranges from 3-5 LPA. The top companies that recruit students are generally local companies in the city. Approximately 30-35% of students get internships.
content.Infrastructure: The campus has a Wi-Fi facility and well-made labs. Classrooms are big and well-accommodated. The library is well-stocked with books and highly resourceful. The hostel food is good. The college campus has a canteen, and it is the best thing. There is a full garden, and the college is surrounded by greenery all around.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: In my opinion, students should not take admission to this college.

content.Placements: None of the students get placed in our course so if students are searching for placements then they should not come to this college. If there is no placement then there will be no package and there will be no companies too. No companies will come to provide internships. Top roles are not offered in our course.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is only okay and not so good at our college. There is Wi-Fi in our college, but the Wi-Fi doesn't have high speed. Classrooms do not have AC and the library doesn't have silence in it. Hostels are bad too like class and fans don't work properly in it.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: All things are good, but placements are too slow.

content.Placements: Companies for internships as well as placements are coming to select candidates. However, the process has been affected in the past year due to changes in the placement officer. Now, the new placement officer is working too fast to provide good placement opportunities for students enrolled in this course.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel has good infrastructure and a good environment, with each student having their room. Facilities such as proper drinking RO water are available at all times. Proper facilities of hygienic bathrooms and toilets are provided here. Proper care of students is maintained here.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: There are no placements, and you should not take admission to this college.

content.Placements: The placement scene at our college is really disappointing. There are zero campus placements and no help with finding internships. The placement cell doesn't do much and students are left to figure things out on their own. It's frustrating especially when you expect some support for your career from the college, and they don't provide any placements or internships.
content.Infrastructure: The food in our mess is just terrible, tasteless, oily, and the same boring stuff every day. Half the time, it's not even fresh. Eating here feels like a punishment. The infrastructure is average. Hostels don't have AC for the summer, making them feel like the worst.

faqs.question: Does William Carey University have good placements?
faqs.answer: William Carrey University is a private institution established in 1892 in Meghalaya, Shillong. This university in Shillong was established in 2005 by the Government of Meghalaya and named after William Carey, a renowned English Baptist missionary. It is recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and accredited by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). The placement of this college has done an excellent job in placing more that 50% of its students every year. Companies like Akash, Byju, Chegg, Havells, Zigram, Physics Wallah, TCS, Amazon, Flipkart, and Mahindra have visited the campus for placements for various posts like research assistant, business analyst, project manager, and subject matter expert. The highest package offered till date has been around 15 Lpa for the post of data scientist and average packages were more than 4 LPA for the profiles like research assistant and subject matter expert. So with WCU you will be in safe hands in terms of excelling and succeeding in your career. At WCU you will be able to work in your dream company.

faqs.question: How are BSc placements at William Carey University?
faqs.answer: The placement cell of William Carey University is fantastic. They train students and invite companies to recruit them. With that the college has achieved a marvelous placement track record over the past several years. Companies like Akash, Byju, Chegg, Havells, Zigram, Physics Wallah, TCS, Amazon, Flipkart, and Mahindra visit the campus for placements. These companies recruit students for various posts like research assistant, business analyst, project manager, and subject matter expert. The highest package offered till date has been around 15 Lpa for the post of data scientist and average packages were more than 4 LPA for the profiles like research assistant and subject matter expert. The institution also provides you with internships and an opportunity for practical work and help you in all-around development. Our college also helps you to have exposure to practical knowledge during your graduation course. You can rest assured knowing that your time in William Carey University will be worth every thing given the mission and vision the college has for all of its students.

faqs.question: Are government jobs offered to BA graduates from William Carey University?
faqs.answer: William Carey University BA graduates can apply for government jobs in their field or another field. For most government jobs, graduation from UGC-approved colleges and William Carey University has UGC approval along with AICTE & PCI. A graduation degree also makes candidates eligible for higher studies, which can help them secure government jobs in teaching, research, and manufacturing. Alumni from the institution have applied and been selected as IPS officers in the state and other parts of the country.

faqs.answer: Top companies from around the world like Mercedes, Toyota, Hyundai, and many more come in for placements at William Carey University.
